Ty Jerome is off to a historic start. After pouring in 31 more points against the Kings, he leads the NBA in scoring at 34.7 points per game as the Grizzlies move to 3-0!
He has scored 104 points through the first three games of the 2026-27 season, making him the second player in Grizzlies history to top 100 in that span.
